title: Other Discoveries, 1936-7: Nablus Sub-District. Nablus
author: (round-up, Department of Antiquities)
location_note: East end of the railway station, Nablus; no map reference; placed by name.
notes: Remains uncovered while preparing a petrol depot: wall foundations, paved hall, a vaulted chamber (function not given), apse, column. No eligible feature.
